title: From Anger to Joy: How Nationality Personas Shape Emotion Attribution in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning nationality-specific personas (representing 110 countries) to LLMs and prompting them to attribute emotions to various events from the ISEAR dataset. The outputs are then analyzed for regional disparities, compared against Hofstede's cultural dimensions, and evaluated for alignment with human ground-truth responses.

Conducting an intersectional analysis by appending gender attributes (male or female) to the nationality personas and observing how the LLMs' emotion attributions shift based on gender, specifically looking for stereotyped emotional associations (e.g., anger with men, sadness with women).
